summary.description: Two to four sentences: what the change alters that a reader would notice, and whether the documentation still matches.

docs_source.description: What the report rests on: excerpts retrieved from a collection, documentation files read from the repository, both, or none at all.

drifts.description: Statements the change made untrue, most misleading first. Empty when there are none.

document.description: The document the statement is in: a path, or the excerpt's source name.

statement.description: The stale statement, quoted as written.

why_stale.description: What in the change makes it untrue.

suggested_edit.description: The wording that would make it true again.

kind.description: stale = a statement the change made untrue; missing = something new that no document mentions.

human_summary.description: Written LAST. A note for the author in Markdown: what was checked against (or that nothing was, and how to fix that), then each stale statement and its fix.
